title: Dark tilted dashboard drift tour
summary: Seven close-ups of a dark dev-tool dashboard leaned back in steep perspective, each a single constant-speed drift in a new direction, lit by a soft spot that fades the plane into black; then a flat wordmark and mark.
use_when: A dense developer or analytics tool whose UI looks ordinary flat but expensive in depth
A silent product tour where staging, not copy, carries the film
Dark-themed products with one bright focal element per screen
A 30-40 s loopable showcase for a landing page hero or feed

look.type_style: small UI sans (dashboard labels ~1.5-2 % H on the plane); end wordmark medium-weight grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, ~6 % H, centred

sfx.event: each hard cut to a new dashboard close-up
wordmark appears after the black frames

structure.shot: whole app on a tilted plane: sidebar nav and a request table, table panel floating on its own layer above the sidebar
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateX 30-35 deg, rotateY about -15 deg; dolly left 3.1 px/fr @1920, push-in 1.00->1.031 over 127 fr (0.74 %/s)
structure.motion: fade-up from black 15 fr, easings.outQuint (70 % in the first 10 fr); camera easings.linear, speed thirds equal; two-layer parallax

structure.shot: close-up of the status and method columns of the table, row pills in green and blue
structure.camera: dolly up 2.6 px/fr @1920, push-in 1.00->1.18 over 98 fr (5.5 %/s), the only fast push
structure.motion: camera easings.linear, no settle; 1-frame white flash on entry (luma about 3x for 1 fr)

structure.shot: component render list with counts, icons and status pills on the right, steep lean
structure.camera: dolly up 1.5 px/fr @1920 (list scrolls up the tilt), scale about 1.00
structure.motion: camera easings.linear; focus band through the middle third, edges about 4-6x softer

structure.shot: area chart with four peaks plus sidebar and filter column, almost flat angle: the breather
structure.camera: static pan (0.05 px/fr), pull-out 1.00->0.977 over 126 fr (-0.56 %/s)
structure.motion: chart already drawn on entry (no draw-on visible at 0.25 s); camera easings.linear

structure.shot: diagnosis detail panel at an extreme angle: bright white prompt pill with glow, cause text, three proportion bars
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateX about 45 deg, rotateZ about -20 deg; dolly down 1.1 px/fr @1920, push-in +0.37 %/s
structure.motion: camera easings.linear; glow held on the pill as the single focal target

structure.shot: state-change log with a code diff: red and green highlighted lines, glowing prompt pill above
structure.camera: dolly right 2.6 px/fr @1920, push-in +0.92 %/s, roll -1.0 deg/s (only roll in the film)

structure.shot: floating complexity card: severity chip, four metric figures, four cost bars in cyan, violet, green, orange
structure.camera: dolly left 1.1 px/fr @1920, pull-out 1.00->0.94 over 141 fr (-1.4 %/s), slight easings.inQuad (speed thirds 0.99/1.13/1.27)
structure.motion: card edges dissolve into black through the spot falloff, no plane edge visible; 2 black frames at 28.60 before the next shot

structure.shot: product wordmark, light grey, centred on flat near-black
structure.motion: appears by cut, no entrance visible at 0.25 s; holds 86 fr

structure.shot: product mark alone, metallic grey gradient, centred; faint light diagonal in the top-left corner
structure.motion: appears by cut, holds 131 fr to the end

params.screens: 6 UI regions rebuilt in React (overview, table detail, list, chart, detail panel, diff, metric card); one bright focal element each
params.shots: per shot {rotateX, rotateY, rotateZ, pan px/fr and direction, scale %/s}; direction must change every shot
params.shotFrames: frames per UI shot (reference 98-141, average 123 at 30 fps)
params.flashFirstCut: 1-frame white flash on the first cut only (default true)
params.dof: focus band through the middle third, edge blur 6-12 px @1920
params.spot: soft spot falloff to near-black before the plane edge
params.endCard: wordmark hold then mark hold, frames (default 86 + 131)

notes: Timings and camera numbers from a human frame-by-frame measurement (ORB + RANSAC per shot), confirmed against the sheets. cuts.json found 0 hard cuts on this very dark footage (near misses at 7.50, 11.03, 15.23, 19.77, 23.90); rows use the sheet-visible shot changes. Every UI shot is one linear vector (speed thirds equal within 5 %), no ease-in, no settle; cuts land mid-move. Direction alternates left, up, up, none, down, right, left. Background is #0C0C0D, never pure black. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): spot-falloff, tilt-shift-band, vector-alternation. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured: the reference is silent.
